            ],
            "name": "For org testing8",
            "tags": [
                "Fiber optic network",
                " Telecom",
                " Infrastructure",
                " GeoSpatial"
            ],
            "label": "For org testing8",
            "description": "This dataset catalogs detailed attributes for each fiber-optic cable span managed by T-Fiber, the state-owned internet and fiber-optic service provider in Telangana, India. Each record represents a continuous cable segment, identified by a unique span identifier and a descriptive route name. For every segment, the dataset records both the map-based length and the actual installed length in meters, the construction method used, the number of ducts occupied, and the type of crossing encountered. It also specifies which side of the corridor or roadway the cable runs along, and classifies the type of structure at the starting attachment point.\n \n In addition to textual and numeric attributes, the dataset includes geographic details such as the start and end location names, their respective X and Y coordinates in the spatial reference system, and a geometry field that encodes the precise route shape. Field engineers’ notes appear in both general remarks and observation summaries, while mobile data collection entries provide supplementary comments and links to mobile-captured images. A source feature identifier links each segment back to its origin in external systems. The dataset collectively represents the full inventory of cable segments laid out across the region, covering all technical, geographic, and field-collected metadata necessary for comprehensive network management. The dataset covers records entered between 2023 and 2025.",
